function.name: get_current_weather

Sure thing! To craft an itinerary that feels just right for you, I’d love to know a bit more about your preferences:

| What I’d like to know | Why it matters |
|-----------------------|----------------|
| **Interests** (e.g., museums, food, nightlife, outdoor activities, theater) | Helps prioritize activities |
| **Budget** (accommodation, dining, tickets) | Keeps the plan realistic |
| **Travel companions** (solo, couple, family, friends) | Influences lodging & group-friendly options |
| **Accommodation type** (hotel, Airbnb, hostel, boutique) | Affects location & vibe |
| **Transportation** (public transit, car rental, walking) | Determines how you’ll move around |
| **Any must‑see spots or events** (e.g., Broadway show, holiday markets, sports game) | Ensures they’re included |
| **Dining preferences** (budget, cuisine, dietary restrictions) | Guides restaurant suggestions |
| **Typical daily schedule** (morning, afternoon, evening) | Helps structure the day |

If you’re happy with a general “New York City in December” plan, I can draft a sample 5‑day itinerary right away. Just let me know which option you prefer!
